body: real-sqrt, real-abs, real-min and real-max come from Gpu chapter DeviceMath, which has correct portable bodies; the WGSL and PTX plugs replace the calls with hardware instructions on the GPU. cordic-sin and cordic-cos are the names the emitters intercept for the hardware sine and cosine; their bodies delegate to DeviceMath so a CPU compile computes the right answer too. atan2 is a real CORDIC below. Nothing here lies.
